description: Worktrees, two ways. Path-addressed (add, remove, lock, unlock, prune, repair) drives plain git worktree and needs nothing but git. Branch-addressed (flow_add, flow_remove, flow_list, flow_path) drives git flow worktree: it addresses worktrees by branch name, computes paths from the gitflow.worktreePath template, and tags provenance so cleanup can tell a git-flow-created worktree (removed) from a hand-made one (detached, work preserved). The flow_* actions require git-flow-next on PATH.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the local Git repository. If omitted, falls back to the server default set via the GIT_REPO_PATH environment variable or --repo-path CLI argument.

name: git_worktree
title: Git Worktree
